items.title: Ornate Border Slat Medallion DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Gates
items.description: A dense floral border frames wide horizontal slats interrupted by an off-center circular medallion built from swirling vines and a small central rosette. Placing the medallion slightly off the panel's midline gives this design a more relaxed, asymmetrical balance than the perfectly centered medallions elsewhere in the collection.

items.title: Celtic Knot Thistle Scroll DXF Panel for Heritage Gate Designs
items.description: An interwoven Celtic knot forms the heart of a tall thistle-like motif, framed above and below by symmetrical scrollwork. The heritage, interlaced design suits Scottish-style gates, estate doors, and formal garden screens.
